entries.summary: All 4 plan steps completed on branch feature/event-chat-reminders-opt-in; ./gradlew compileJava succeeded.
entries.detail: Before branching, stashed coffer-alert-text-only's uncommitted tracked-file changes (README.md, CofferAlertListener.java, AlertsApiClient.java - that task is still qa_review, not shipped) via `git stash push` scoped to just those 3 files, then branched feature/event-chat-reminders-opt-in off a clean main. The .mflow task folders for both tasks are untracked and were left in place across the branch switch (untracked files aren't branch-scoped). Added CatastrophicEventsConfig.eventRemindersEnabled() (default false) and gated both checkReminderMilestones() and announceSignedUpEvents() in CatastrophicEventsPlugin.java with an early return. README.md updated. No live game session available in this environment - confirming reminders stay silent when off and fire correctly when on is on the developer before shipping.

entries.author: mike
entries.summary: IMPORTANT for whoever picks up bugfix/coffer-alert-text-only or feature/event-chat-reminders-opt-in next: neither branch has any commits yet, so they currently share identical git history and only differ in uncommitted working-tree state.
entries.detail: Checking out one branch from the other carries the CURRENT uncommitted changes along rather than swapping to that branch's own changes, because git has nothing committed to distinguish them - this happened twice while tidying up after execution (had to re-stash and re-pop to untangle event-chat-reminders-opt-in's changes from coffer-alert-text-only's). Both branches' working trees are now confirmed correct as of this entry (verified by inspecting stash diffs directly, not by re-checking out). Recommend committing each task's changes on its own branch as soon as possible (via ship-task or otherwise) before switching between them again, to stop this from recurring.
